plan_gaps.summary: The Change-URL bound is not specified at the repository level.
plan_gaps.location: plan.md — Implementation approach step 2; Linked Change bounds; acceptance criterion 8
plan_gaps.evidence: The prior draft capped public URLs but did not require a limit-six-per-Change query; existing bulk readers load every URL for selected Events.
plan_gaps.impact: An implementation could slice an unbounded URL collection in memory while appearing publicly bounded.
plan_gaps.recommendation: Require one project-leading bulk/window query with at most six code-unit-ordered URLs per emitted Change and D1/PostgreSQL overflow fixtures.

plan_gaps.summary: The provider-collation requirement conflicts with preserving Measurement plan fact validation.
plan_gaps.location: plan.md — Measurement metric bounds and acceptance criteria 10–11
plan_gaps.evidence: storedPlanFact hashes the Metric array in the existing repository order. Changing that shared query to BINARY/C can reorder legacy mixed-case/non-ASCII Metrics and invalidate stored hashes.
plan_gaps.impact: A parity change could reject already valid Measurement Plans.
plan_gaps.recommendation: Preserve exact validator order and apply code-unit ordering only to a separate bounded public projection after validation, with ordering-sensitive regression facts.
